page_title: INT 2-0 EMP | Inter v Empoli 01/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Federico Dionisi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) has tested the patience of referee Federico Dionisi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrikh Mkhitaryan departs the field of play to be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Mattia Destro (Empoli) is replacing M'Baye Niang.
82' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replaces Emmanuel Gyasi.
81' 2 - 0 Goal! Denzel Dumfries puts the ball across the area and Alexis Sanchez (Inter) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:0.
81' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
77' Substitution. Lautaro Martinez walks off the pitch and Alexis Sanchez (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
77' Here comes a substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Bastoni.
76' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Simone Bastoni will be replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
73' Substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) replaces Giuseppe Pezzella.
73' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
72' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Inter win a corner.

71' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Elia Caprile.
69' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Federico Dimarco and he is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
69' That's the end of the game for Hakan Calhanoglu, who is replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
67' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort high over the bar.
66' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes a direct free kick.
66' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
65' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

65' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
63' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends the corner into the box, but Elia Caprile intercepts it and averts the threat.
62' A short pass finds Simone Bastoni (Empoli). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
61' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
59' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
57' The corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared away by the defence.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Empoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
53' The referee blows his whistle after M'Baye Niang (Empoli) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
52' Federico Dimarco has a look up and finds Nicolo Barella (Inter) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
51' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
49' The foul by Marcus Thuram (Inter) was seen by Federico Dionisi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Inter fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Empoli) leaps to collect the ball.

48' Nicolo Barella (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Federico Dionisi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
42' The resulting corner, taken by Simone Bastoni (Empoli), comes to nothing.
41' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Empoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' A cross from a corner kick by Inter is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
37' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Inter will take a corner kick.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Empoli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
30' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
27' Razvan Marin (Empoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

27' Razvan Marin (Empoli) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
24' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
21' Matteo Darmian (Inter) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' None of the Empoli players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
19' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
19' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
14' Matteo Darmian (Inter) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
13' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
11' The Empoli players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Flag up against Marcus Thuram (Inter). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Federico Dimarco (Inter) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) jumps above the defenders in order to convert a lofted cross with a nice header. Elia Caprile makes a reflexive save to block his effort from hitting the net.
2' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The first half has started.
Empoli will kick-off.
